meta.name: dialogue-audio
meta.description: Multi-speaker dialogue audio creation with ElevenLabs and Dia TTS. Covers speaker tags, emotion control, pacing, conversation flow, and post-production. Use for: podcasts, audiobooks, explainers, character dialogue, conversational content. Triggers: dialogue audio, multi speaker, conversation audio, dia tts, two speakers, podcast audio, character voices, voice acting, dialogue generation, conversation tts, multi voice, speaker tags, dialogue recording, elevenlabs dialogue, eleven labs conversation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多角色对话生成播客、有声书和配音内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI生成多说话人对话音频，用于播客、有声书或教学解说。
copy.tagline_en: Generate multi-speaker dialogue audio for podcasts, audiobooks, and voiceovers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create multi-speaker dialogue audio for podcasts, audiobooks, or explainers.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Dia TTS 生成双人对话音频。它通过 [S1] 和 [S2] 标签区分说话人，并利用标点符号和括号内的声音描述（如 (laughs)）控制情感与节奏。
howto.when: 当你提到“对话音频”、“双人对话”、“播客音频”等关键词，或要求生成多说话人对话音频时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段双人对话音频，主题是介绍新产品。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Dia TTS 生成对话音频。

say.text: 用 [S1] 和 [S2] 写一段采访格式的对话，带情感提示。
say.note: Claude 会生成带情感控制的对话脚本并转为音频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate two-speaker dialogue audio using Dia TTS. It uses [S1] and [S2] tags to distinguish speakers, and controls emotion and pacing via punctuation and parenthetical sound descriptions (e.g., (laughs)).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'dialogue audio', 'multi speaker', 'conversation audio', 'podcast audio', or ask to generate multi-speaker dialogue audio.

say_en.text: Generate a two-speaker dialogue audio about introducing a new product.
say_en.note: Claude will use Dia TTS to create the audio.

say_en.text: Write an interview-style dialogue with [S1] and [S2] tags and emotional cues.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a script with emotion control and convert it to audio.
